title: Teeth-in-one-day marketing question stays in the knowledge-base branch
description: The caller asks what the clinic means by the marketing phrase 'zeby w jeden dzien'. The assistant should answer from the knowledge base, connect it to implant treatment or All on four, and avoid drifting into scheduling or handoff flows.

turns.user: Co oznacza haslo zeby w jeden dzien? Na czym polega takie leczenie?

rubric.description: The assistant should consult the knowledge base for the marketing phrase question.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant answered the marketing phrase without searchKnowledgeBase

rubric.description: The knowledge base should return a supported answer for the marketing phrase.
rubric.root_cause_hint: All on four marketing retrieval drifted

rubric.description: The answer should connect the phrase to implant treatment or All on four.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant surfaced the KB answer too vaguely

rubric.description: A pure explanatory question must not trigger immediate scheduling.
